q1_issues.issue: The compound 'weekly_market' gets only its head genus; the modifier genus (Inheritance weekly_market weekly) is missing, although 'weekly' is an adjective that passes the stated predication test ('the market is weekly') and the same parse exposes 'inland' for inland_farm.

notes: The coordinated origin PP is split into one rule per conjunct per the distributive default, and the bare-plural habitual correctly takes the 0.9/0.9 Skolem-event rule form with the restriction as a premise conjunct and one shared market witness. The 'weekly' call is borderline because the exposure rule enumerates only gradable, positional/cardinal and material adjectives even though its own part-of-speech/predication test admits a temporal adjective.
